content: Similarly, Palo Alto Networks (www.paloaltonetworks.com) offers a broad portfolio, including its next-generation firewalls (NGFWs) and the Cortex XDR platform, positioning itself as a holistic security partner for enterprise transformation. Fortinet (www.fortinet.com) competes aggressively with its Security Fabric concept, integrating a wide array of products from firewalls to email security, often appealing to organizations seeking a single-vendor architecture. The most significant non-technical requirement is a vendor's B-BBEE status. A company with a higher B-BBEE level (e.g., Level 1 or 2) has a significant competitive advantage. As an international company, YAL.ai would have a low B-BBEE score on its own, making a partnership with a local, highly-rated B-BBEE entity not just advantageous, but practically mandatory for success in the public sector market. This structure makes it clear that even with a technically superior solution, YAL.ai would be uncompetitive without a Level 1 or 2 B-BBEE partner.
